nodes.norm_label: <weave_data> wrapper: stored text is data, not instructions

nodes.label: MCP injection measurement harness
nodes.rationale: Defensive measurement of whether an agent reading a workspace through MCP acts on instructions planted in stored data; never touches a real workspace.

nodes.label: ONB-04 Returning user opens intended workspace or row
nodes.norm_label: onb-04 returning user opens intended workspace or row

nodes.label: ONB-11 No-access notice naming the linked workspace
nodes.norm_label: onb-11 no-access notice naming the linked workspace

nodes.label: ONB-12 Invite link with no login resumes after sign-in
nodes.norm_label: onb-12 invite link with no login resumes after sign-in

nodes.label: ONB-13 AI app sign-in via weave sign-in page and OAuth return
nodes.norm_label: onb-13 ai app sign-in via weave sign-in page and oauth return

nodes.label: Record file ledger and Files card
nodes.norm_label: record file ledger and files card

nodes.label: Sandboxed HTML view (GET /api/files/:id?view)
nodes.rationale: The sandbox keeps uploaded HTML off the workspace's origin; the frame is sized only from its own window's messages.

nodes.label: Upload flow: 10 MB limit, tiles, retry, failure reasons
nodes.norm_label: upload flow: 10 mb limit, tiles, retry, failure reasons
nodes.rationale: On a timeout or 504 weave reads the row again before reporting failure, since the server may have stored the file before its answer was lost.

nodes.label: Base SHA-256 conflict check (412)
nodes.rationale: So two sessions on one token never write over each other.

nodes.label: Description role (first document)
nodes.rationale: The first document is a role, not a name: the table points at it by id, so renaming keeps it the description.

nodes.label: Document revisions and restore
nodes.rationale: Writes by the same actor within ten minutes fold into one revision so a keystroke log never builds up; a restore never overwrites what it replaces.

nodes.label: avatar field
nodes.rationale: An icon says what kind of record this is and belongs to the table; an avatar says which record it is, so an avatar never takes an icon from the inventory.

nodes.label: api() in public/billing.js
nodes.rationale: A different module-local function from api() in public/app.js; both resolve to the same server routes.

nodes.label: CORE-01 Product still opens tables, documents, entity detail and views
nodes.norm_label: core-01 product still opens tables, documents, entity detail and views

nodes.label: Explicit remaining coverage (devices, live providers)
nodes.rationale: Auto-merge is permission to land tested code, not proof of live-provider availability or production deployment.

nodes.label: Keeping the series current
nodes.rationale: Red checks must not be resolved with skips, unconditional retries or lower assertions; gate changes need negative tests proving missing/failed evidence cannot pass.

nodes.label: Merge decision (ONBOARDING inventory, PR gate, Dev gate, security scan)
nodes.norm_label: merge decision (onboarding inventory, pr gate, dev gate, security scan)
nodes.rationale: A passing gate permits merging without separate approval; main CI and dev soak remain separate production-promotion controls.

nodes.label: ONB-03 Optional AI setup and simulated connector
nodes.norm_label: onb-03 optional ai setup and simulated connector

nodes.label: Onboarding verification contract
nodes.rationale: Journeys are release behavior, not a one-time audit checklist; deleting coverage or skipping a broken test is not a fix.

nodes.label: Date costume (format)
nodes.rationale: Comparison, sorting and date math run on the stored value, so changing the format changes nothing but the reading.

nodes.label: Date grain (stored parts)
nodes.rationale: Storing a missing part would store a lie, so the grain leaves it out.

nodes.label: Formulas read raw values, not costumes
nodes.norm_label: formulas read raw values, not costumes
nodes.rationale: Keeps Price * Count from breaking when display formatting changes.

nodes.label: ONB-14 Clerk offers same methods at sign-up and sign-in
nodes.norm_label: onb-14 clerk offers same methods at sign-up and sign-in

nodes.label: ENTITY_UNDO in public/app.js
nodes.rationale: The browser sends no comment write, so the regex table that classifies writes for undo lists no comment routes.

nodes.label: HTTP routes no browser code calls
nodes.norm_label: http routes no browser code calls
nodes.rationale: The CLI and MCP tools run commands in process, so these routes serve outside HTTP API clients with bearer tokens.

nodes.label: Browser to server routes
nodes.rationale: No import joins public/app.js to src/, so the route table joins the front end to the server handlers.

nodes.label: WEB-01 Website signup CTA preserves signup intent
nodes.norm_label: web-01 website signup cta preserves signup intent

nodes.label: Formulas have a check step
nodes.rationale: Saving an invalid expression is rejected with the same error the check returns, so checking first costs nothing; a scan catches a formula valid on record 1 and null elsewhere.

nodes.label: Hosted agent sign-in: /mcp as OAuth 2.1 protected resource
nodes.norm_label: hosted agent sign-in: /mcp as oauth 2.1 protected resource

nodes.label: One MCP server is one workspace
nodes.norm_label: one mcp server is one workspace
nodes.rationale: Because one workspace is one file.

nodes.label: Operator verbs: weave backup and weave restore
nodes.norm_label: operator verbs: weave backup and weave restore
nodes.rationale: They have no MCP tool on purpose: an agent holding a token must not be able to ship the keystore off the box or overwrite the store under a running server.

nodes.label: Provider sign-in (OIDC), invites and linked accounts
nodes.norm_label: provider sign-in (oidc), invites and linked accounts

nodes.label: Registry records are the schema verbs (System/Spaces, Tables, Fields)
nodes.norm_label: registry records are the schema verbs (system/spaces, tables, fields)

nodes.label: Schema document round-trips
nodes.rationale: Omitted spaces, tables and fields are deletions, which is why they need allowDestructive.

nodes.label: Schema version stamp and per-space versions (etag)
nodes.norm_label: schema version stamp and per-space versions (etag)

nodes.label: Secrets never come back to an agent
nodes.norm_label: secrets never come back to an agent
nodes.rationale: Permission lives on the credential, not on the field: the field's value was never the secret, so no view, formula or export needs a new check.

nodes.label: Formula check (weave formula check, weave_check_formula)
nodes.rationale: A formula valid on record 1 and null on a third of the table is the bug one preview cannot show, hence the 200-record scan.

nodes.label: Build in one call
nodes.rationale: The spec runs first on an in-memory copy of the workspace, so dryRun returns every error at once and a spec with any error writes nothing; existing parts are reused so resending the whole spec after an error is safe.

nodes.label: The CLI mirrors all of it
nodes.norm_label: the cli mirrors all of it

nodes.label: Local file uploads (upload grant)
nodes.rationale: File bytes never need to enter the model context, and no separate editor token is needed.

nodes.label: Self-documenting workspace
nodes.rationale: Handbook pages are generated from src/handbook/, so edit a page there, not on the running instance; a guide you wrote yourself is never touched.

nodes.label: Surfaces: MCP stdio, MCP HTTP, REST, CLI, Browser UI
nodes.norm_label: surfaces: mcp stdio, mcp http, rest, cli, browser ui

nodes.label: Tool map (66 MCP tools, 17 listed by default)
nodes.norm_label: tool map (66 mcp tools, 17 listed by default)
nodes.rationale: The full tool list costs about 12,000 tokens on every turn and a build uses about twelve tools, so the default lists only those (Issue #595).

nodes.label: ONB-07 Invite creation, copy, revocation and email feedback
nodes.norm_label: onb-07 invite creation, copy, revocation and email feedback

nodes.label: graphify (PyPI graphifyy)
nodes.rationale: graphify is a development tool and never a weave dependency.

nodes.label: Blind spots
nodes.rationale: The structure pass cannot see HTTP links between browser and server or symbols inside immediately invoked functions, so the page records them by hand and the docs pass picks them up.

nodes.label: Code graph (docs/graph.md)
nodes.rationale: Query the graph before reading a monolith end to end: it answers what calls this, what breaks if I change this and how two symbols connect in under a second, with file and line for every hit.

nodes.label: .graphifyignore
nodes.rationale: Without it, public/vendor/mermaid.min.js alone adds 3,203 nodes and fake hubs named t() and r().

nodes.label: Refreshing the graph
nodes.rationale: Refresh after a large refactor, a module split or a new top-level directory, and with each release; extract sends only changed docs to the model because the semantic cache is committed and keyed by file content.

nodes.label: Self-contained browser scripts
nodes.rationale: Eight files wrap their code in an immediately invoked function and declare no top-level symbols, so the table lists what each defines and exposes.

nodes.label: Using it (graphify commands)
nodes.rationale: Name a symbol qualified by its file, because every function the tables cite also has a stub node under docs/graph.md, so a bare name can come back ambiguous; query matches keywords and can miss the code you mean.

nodes.label: Errors carry one code on every door
nodes.norm_label: errors carry one code on every door

nodes.label: CI gate (tests workflow on main)
nodes.rationale: Shards are weighted by recorded duration_ms because byte size balances poorly: the slowest browser files are small files that loop.

nodes.label: Required checks: Dev gate, PR gate, security scan
nodes.norm_label: required checks: dev gate, pr gate, security scan

nodes.label: security scan check
nodes.rationale: Downloads retry across 120 seconds because a failed download of a required check stops every pull request (Issue #1490).

nodes.label: Sheriff (owns a red main)
nodes.rationale: Only the rerun's CI gate conclusion decides guilt; a cancelled rerun is no second red.

nodes.label: Supervisor swap, watch and rollback
nodes.rationale: A release whose deferred migration wrote to a workspace is never rolled back automatically; old code never runs on a schema a newer release migrated.

nodes.label: Dev smoke and soak
nodes.rationale: A new main merge never ends or restarts a window, because the soak exists to review a batch.

nodes.label: Production promotion
nodes.rationale: Never hand-deploy Railway: a platform redeploy restarts the container, drops requests for up to a minute and resets the supervisor; production is never rewound.

nodes.label: Space rollup (via a whole table, Σ row)
nodes.norm_label: space rollup (via a whole table, σ row)
nodes.rationale: All footer values live at the space level (Kyle, 2026-09-06).

nodes.label: Grid as ledger and the entity dock
nodes.norm_label: grid as ledger and the entity dock

nodes.label: Home page, space page and starter templates
nodes.norm_label: home page, space page and starter templates

nodes.label: Grid keyboard model (cells rest as values)
nodes.norm_label: grid keyboard model (cells rest as values)

nodes.label: Permalinks, link previews and prefilled create links
nodes.norm_label: permalinks, link previews and prefilled create links

nodes.label: Move to trash and Delete forever
nodes.norm_label: move to trash and delete forever

nodes.label: Workspace settings, rail and delete workspace
nodes.norm_label: workspace settings, rail and delete workspace

nodes.label: Number display graphics (bar, ring, heat, scale, color)
nodes.norm_label: number display graphics (bar, ring, heat, scale, color)

nodes.label: Rating max config (1-100 icons)
nodes.rationale: The ceiling of 100 keeps a screen of records paintable: every icon is a button in every visible cell.

nodes.label: Target set (polymorphic relation, targetDbs)
nodes.rationale: A target set is one-way: no inverse field is minted because it would have to be sprayed across every member table.

nodes.label: Ten-hue option palette
nodes.rationale: Slate is the honest default: a colour should carry meaning, not decoration.

nodes.label: Text column migrations
nodes.rationale: The engine refuses a migration that would have to invent data.

nodes.label: Name field (entity identity, record term)
nodes.rationale: It cannot be deleted, because a record needs an identity.

nodes.label: number field type
nodes.rationale: A formula reads the raw number, never the costume: a formula that received the formatted string would break the moment someone turned on grouping.

nodes.label: relation field type
nodes.rationale: Name the field for what is on the other end; the field name is what the chip reads and what every lookup path starts with.

nodes.label: rollup field type
nodes.rationale: A rollup crosses a relation; a formula stays on the record. Reaching for a formula where a rollup does the job yields a number that will not update.

nodes.label: url field type
nodes.rationale: Dangerous schemes (javascript:, data:, vbscript:, blob:, file:) rest as a text box so a stored string can never run in the reader's tab.
